description: Réseaux de chaleur urbains de Rennes Métropole is a dataset listed in Rennes-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Rennes Métropole. Les Réseaux de Chaleur Urbains (RCU) fonctionnent sur le principe suivant: des chaufferies produisent de la chaleur qui est ensuite distribuée aux abonnés via des canalisations souterraines. Cette couche localise le tracé des réseaux de chaleur urbains sur le territoire de Rennes Métropole. Coverage: Rennes Métropole. The portal files it under Réseaux, Energie. Its keywords are réseau de chauffage urbain. The portal shows 6,541 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2022-07-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ODbL 1.0 (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support heat network planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-rennesmetropole-fr-portal.
